description: PyPSA-FES constructs British power-system scenarios from Future Energy Scenarios inputs and optimises investment and operation. It includes household demand shifting, smart heat pumps and electric-vehicle charging flexibility. The provider is centrefornetzero (repository owner). Coverage: The README covers years 2023–2050, a 16-zone British network and hourly runs for a full year. Neighbouring countries are single nodes. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: Code is MIT-licensed; Future Energy Scenarios and other source inputs have separate terms. Limitations: Leading the Way and Falling Short are scenario assumptions. Aggregated zones and centrally optimised flexibility do not establish actual future consumer behaviour or network operation. For simulation it supports comparisons of transition pathways and domestic electricity flexibility. Related resources: The workflow extends the PyPSA family, represented by model-pypsa; it is a distinct British scenario model.
